notes.subject: janya
notes.rationale: אף is literally 'nose/nostril' — anger pictured as flaring nostrils; janya (anger) loses the body image.

notes.subject: מחרון אפך
notes.rationale: 'Burning of your nose' = fierce anger; rendered tasuma bɔ i ka janya la (the burning of your anger).

notes.subject: שבת (85:2)/השיבות
notes.rationale: Root shuv returns from v2 — God now 'turns back' His anger as He 'turned' the captivity; the echo is lost.

translation: I ye i ka timisirili bɛɛ lajɛ, i y'i ka tasuma bɔ i ka janya la.
